description: Use this when the user gives a DOI, PubMed id or arXiv id and wants the paper's abstract or a free full-text link, such as "get the abstract for DOI 10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2". Pass exactly one of doi, pmid or arxiv_id. Returns the title, authors, year, venue, the start of the abstract, the free full-text link and license when the index confirms them, and the index it came from. It does not say whether the paper was retracted or whether a reference is correct.

arxiv_id.description: arXiv id such as "2401.12345"; an arxiv.org link also works

doi.description: DOI such as "10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2"; a doi.org link also works

name: get_paper

asOf.description: Date the indexes were read (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD); they are updated continuously

error.description: Present when status is not ok: a stable code, what went wrong and what to do next.

citedBy.description: Citation count in this source; sources count differently

license.description: License of the open copy when the source states it

openAccessUrl.description: A link to the full text that is free to read; null when the source does not confirm one, which does not mean none exists

source.description: The indexes the answer was read from

title: Get a paper
